All Around Dogs Canine Wellness offers a unique blend of canine swim therapy and alternative treatments to improve your dog's overall health and well-being. 

From canine swim therapy, and small animal massage therapy to energy work and animal communication for all animals, we provide a holistic approach to dog/companion animal care. 

Services Include: Canine Swim Therapy (Hydro-Therapy), Canine Exercise Swims and Canine Swim Lessons for Dogs of All Ages. Body Work: Canine/Small Animal Massage Therapy, Canine Trigger Point Therapy, Massage for Canine Athletes: Energy Work: Reiki, EFT (Emotional Freedom Techniques) and Animal Communication for All Animals.
